# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-file mobile-first canvas game titled **Arcane Bakewatch: Retro Recipe Recall** from this brief. Preserve the source memory-order mechanic exactly: generate a unique sequence of 3-6 values, display it during a timed memorize phase, shuffle the same items into a bottom pool, let the player tap pool items into the first empty slot and tap slotted items back to the pool, auto-check when all slots are filled, award `100 + level * 50` points and increment level on success, and enter game-over on wrong order with restart.

Theme every visible layer around a retro Overwatch-inspired magical bakery chef. The player is Chef Mira Brio, a heroic support chef defending a neon bakery oven line. Numeric values appear on pastry sigil cards with croissant, cupcake, bread, donut, pie, and macaron forms. Slots are proofing trays. HUD labels use TIPS and SERVICE. The scene uses procedural retro oven grids, sugar particles, teal/orange hero UI, pixel fonts, and compact mobile-readable CTAs. Do not add new mechanics; transform only world meaning, graphics, HUD copy, feedback, and audio tone.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Truth
- genre: mobile-first memory sequence / ordering arcade puzzle
- objective: memorize a generated numeric order, then tap shuffled pieces to rebuild that exact order in the target slots
- input model: pointer/touch taps on canvas tiles; tapping pool tiles fills the first empty slot, tapping slotted tiles returns them to the pool; restart is a button/tap after failure
- core loop: show sequence for a timed memorize window, shuffle tiles to a lower pool, accept tap ordering, auto-check when all slots are filled, award score and advance level when correct, fail to game-over when incorrect
- fail/friction state: wrong completed order shakes the pieces, plays failure feedback, then opens a restart overlay

## Protected Mechanics
- Timed memorize phase uses base time plus time per tile; input is disabled until the recipe/order phase begins.
- Level item count scales from 3 upward every three levels to a cap of 6, using unique values from 1-9.
- Score remains 100 + level * 50 on success; level increments only after a correct completed order.
- The player selects items by tapping/clicking; first empty slot placement, return-to-pool behavior, auto-check-on-full, wrong-order game over, and restart semantics are preserved.

## Remix Direction
The new canonical game is **Arcane Bakewatch: Retro Recipe Recall**. The player is a magical bakery chef in a heroic squad kitchen, reading glowing recipe sigils during a short callout phase and then reassembling shuffled pastry emblems in the same order. The presentation changes radically: retro pixel fonts, orange/cream/teal hero UI, oven-grid arena, chef focal art, pastry-rune tiles, proofing-slot trays, sugar-spark feedback, and kitchen-defense language.
